rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when “dramatically” means in an exaggerated or theatrical way.

example.english: They dramatically made it sound like the end of the world.
example.traditional: 佢誇張咁將件事講到好似世界末日咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kwaa1 zoeng1 gam2 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6 gam2

rows.note: Use this as the precise, all-purpose equivalent in formal or written descriptions of a dramatic manner.
